## Compatibility

v0.1.8 is a non-destructive protocol upgrade from v0.1.7. Preserve project context, state, questions, Working Spec, DRAFT/APPROVED revisions, handoffs, evidence, application source/tests, authority, progress, rejected directions, non-goals and history.

## New framing

- Project Atlas shared substrate
- structured Atlas objects and governed lifecycle
- mandatory provenance
- Gap Objects
- source-of-truth boundaries
- Campaign Themes
- persistent bounded Specialists
- Project Briefing
- Reality Before Reconstruction

## Hosted Agent note

This portable release defines product/protocol framing. Hosted UI/service implementation remains a separate Agent release concern and is gated by the current Campaign Agent test reconciliation.
